# External book data

## CMU Book Summary Dataset
16,559 book plot summaries with aligned metadata.
Source: https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~dbamman/booksummaries.html
License: CC BY-SA 3.0.
Attribution and ShareAlike requirements must be preserved. Each generated record keeps source, URL and license metadata.

## Books for Agents
The public repository contains structured book summaries and declares its content CC BY-SA 4.0.
Repository: https://github.com/danpalmieri/books-for-agents

Do not mix licenses silently. Every imported record must retain provenance and rights metadata.
